flags.text: Profit compounding faster than sales over 3y (26.5% vs 20.9%): operating leverage
Cash conversion strong: 5y operating cash = 101% of profit
Cash cycle stretched by 21 days in 2 years (62 → 83)

guidance.promise: Reach $2 billion in annual revenue by March 2027

claims.claim: Achieved USD 422.5 million revenue with 4% quarter-on-quarter and 17.3% year-on-year growth in Q3 FY26.
claims.quote: We achieved a healthy revenue growth of 4.0% quarter-on-quarter and 17.3% year-on-year, delivering $422.5 million in Q3 of fiscal 2026.

claims.claim: Recorded Total Contract Value of USD 674.5 million with new bookings of USD 369.1 million.
claims.quote: The Total Contract Value for the quarter stood at USD 674.5 million with the Total Contract Value of new bookings coming in at USD 369.1 million.

claims.claim: Delivered EBIT margin of 14.4% and PAT margin of 11.6% for Q3 FY26 after labor code provisioning impact.
claims.quote: After accounting for this impact, the EBIT for the quarter came in at 14.4%... Profit After Tax for the quarter came in at 11.6%

claims.claim: Marked 23rd sequential quarter of revenue growth, reaching $1.6 million trailing twelve-month revenue.
claims.quote: This marks our 23rd sequential quarter of revenue growth.

pushback.topic: Sustainability of 150 bps margin jump from AI tools and pricing
pushback.quote: How should we think about this logically? Because, one, it's a big margin jump in a single quarter.

pushback.topic: Software license revenue growth and intangible asset capitalization
pushback.quote: if I look at the nature of the software license revenue growth, in this quarter it has gone up by 40% q-on-q.

pushback.topic: Hi-tech demand environment and pricing resilience against competition
pushback.quote: Some of our larger peers have indicated that spends are currently kind of tied up in Capex and there's little room for sort of the services or the software stack of it.

calls.tone: Confident, optimistic, and focused on AI-led operational maturity and execution.

guidance.promise: Achieve EBIT margin aspiration in the 16 to 17% range over time
guidance.quote: Our aspiration continues to be in the 16 to 17% range.
guidance.speaker: Vinit Teredesai

guidance.promise: Reach $2 billion run rate by end of FY27
guidance.quote: FY’27, Q4 exit is where we are looking at the run rate being in the range of $500 million or so.
guidance.speaker: Sandeep Kalra

claims.claim: Q4 FY26 revenue achieved USD 436 million, growing 3.2% QoQ and 16.2% YoY.
claims.quote: We achieved a healthy revenue growth of 3.2% quarter-on-quarter and 16.2% year-on-year, delivering USD 436 million in Q4 FY26.

claims.claim: Q4 FY26 EBIT margin came in at 16.3%, up 70 basis points year-on-year.
claims.quote: The EBIT margin for the quarter came in at 16.3%, translating to an EBIT growth of 21.4% and 30.4% QoQ and YoY respectively.

claims.claim: Total Contract Value (TCV) for the quarter stood at USD 600.8 million.
claims.quote: The Total Contract Value for the quarter stood at USD 600.8 million, with Total Contract Value of the new bookings coming in at USD 428.9 million.

claims.claim: Full year FY26 revenue reached USD 1.65 billion, translating to 17.4% YoY growth.
claims.quote: FY26 revenue came in at USD 1.65 billion, translating into 17.4% YoY.

pushback.topic: Demand environment and impact of Middle East war and Generative AI
pushback.quote: can you talk about how are you seeing the demand environment currently versus, let's say, 3 months ago, given the headwinds from geopolitics as well as how enterprises are adopting to Generative AI.

pushback.topic: Top 5 account softness and FY27 $2 billion run-rate target
pushback.quote: Firstly, on the top 5 accounts, they were just slightly soft this quarter. If you could just guide us which vertical sort of contributed to the softness amongst the top 5 clients

pushback.topic: SaaS-pocalypse impact and Private Equity channel exposure
pushback.quote: What is the company's exposure to this channel? Now, with all this talk of SaaS apocalypse, how does this impact demand outlook from this channel for FY’27 and beyond?

calls.tone: Confident, cautiously optimistic, and focused on AI-led capability building and market share gains.

guidance.promise: Transaction expected to be Cash EPS and Reported EPS accretive in Year 1

guidance.promise: Net new deal to add roughly $125M+ annually and $650M+ over 6.5 years

claims.claim: Persistent has achieved a 24 quarter streak of growth
claims.quote: should continue our 24 quarter streak of growth for times to come.

claims.claim: Secured 21% stake in Nagarro via share purchase agreement
claims.quote: It has already secured 21% stake in Nagarro via share purchase agreement from the major shareholder.

pushback.topic: Nagarro valuation multiple and financial books
pushback.quote: My first question was around the books of Nagarro, so have we done any incremental due diligence on the books of Nagarro?

pushback.topic: Integration complexity and margin pressures of Nagarro
pushback.quote: Nagarro revenue has been flat for two years now, and with margin pressure. What gives us confidence that this is a turnaround asset?

pushback.topic: Cash-only funding structure versus share swap risk
pushback.quote: When you're acquiring such a large company, which is almost two-third of the current size, as a risk mitigation strategy, do you think doing some kind of a cash-plus-share swap would have been a better strategy

calls.tone: Confident, enthusiastic, and resolute regarding strategic rationale and integration.

guidance.promise: Achieve 16 to 17 percent EBIT margin range as an aspirational goal

claims.claim: Delivered an EBIT margin of 15% for the quarter.
claims.quote: The EBIT margin for the quarter came in at 15%, translating to an EBIT growth of 1.6% quarter-on-quarter and 19.5% year-on-year.

pushback.topic: Software reinvention services and amortization impact on margins
pushback.quote: is there a cap on the amount of revenue you can have in a deal like this or it has to be through costs coming down.

credibility.line: Only one promise can be checked against reported numbers so far — too few to score.

narrative_vs_numbers.point: Management touts margin improvement but EBIT% fell to 10% versus 16‑17% target.
Revenue growth strong (30.2% YoY) yet no evidence of $2B USD revenue target.
Operating cash flow (0.95 × PAT) confirms cash‑conversion claim.

bull: Revenue YoY 30.2% in Q2 FY27 shows accelerating growth.
Low leverage with D/E 0.07 indicates strong balance sheet.
Operating cash flow nearly equals profit, confirming cash conversion strength.
bear: EBITDA margin slipped to 14% in Q2 FY27 from 19% earlier.
Net profit down 25.3% YoY in Q2 FY27.
watch: Will EBIT margin improve toward 16% target?
Will incremental Nagarro transaction expense appear in next quarter?
